task_completion.description: Log in to the GeoServer admin interface
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the GeoServer 'Welcome' page or dashboard after entering credentials (admin/Admin123!).

task_completion.description: Create a new Gridset named 'WebMercator512' with EPSG:3857
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Gridset Edit' page showing the name 'WebMercator512' and the Coordinate Reference System (CRS) set to 'EPSG:3857'.

task_completion.description: Set tile dimensions to 512x512 and add at least 5 zoom levels
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Gridset configuration, 'Tile width' and 'Tile height' fields both show '512'. The 'Grid Levels' table contains at least 5 rows (Zoom levels).

task_completion.description: Assign the 'WebMercator512' gridset to the 'ne:ne_countries' tile layer
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Tile Layers' configuration page for 'ne:ne_countries' shows 'WebMercator512' added to the 'Gridsets' table.

task_completion.description: Ensure 'image/png' is an allowed tile image format for the layer
task_completion.visual_evidence: On the 'ne:ne_countries' Tile Layer edit page, the checkbox for 'image/png' is checked under 'Tile Image Formats'.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoServer web interface rather than direct API calls or terminal scripts
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the browser, navigation through GeoServer menus (Gridsets, Tile Layers), and form filling.

integrity.description: The agent did not just view existing settings but actively created/modified them
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'New Gridset' page being filled out and the 'Save' button being clicked.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the specific layer 'ne:ne_countries'
integrity.visual_evidence: The layer name 'ne:ne_countries' or 'ne_countries' is visible in the Tile Layers list and configuration headers.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create a NEW gridset. Required values: Name='WebMercator512', CRS='EPSG:3857', Tile Size=512x512, Zoom Levels >= 5. This gridset must then be linked to the 'ne:ne_countries' layer (found under Tile Layers in the GeoWebCache section of the sidebar). The format 'image/png' must be enabled for that specific tile layer.
